claim_tested: Is the MUT-7-binding segment of RDE-2 disordered?
key_finding: MUT-7(633-899):RDE-2(322-567) complex; RDE-2 ordered 326-567 with no density gaps; 41 interface residues and 321 heavy-atom contacts <4 A; helices 328-332/346-350/352-360; strands 368-378/381-385/394-397
context: C. elegans proteins expressed in E. coli BL21(DE3); crystal
confidence_and_limitations: High for the crystallised construct; full-length behaviour and in vivo stoichiometry not shown; Zn site is in MUT-7 (Cys768/771/887/890), not RDE-2

claim_tested: Which subunit of the MUT-7/MUT-8 complex binds RNA?
key_finding: MUT7-C domain of MUT-7 contributes to RNA binding and is crucial for ribonuclease activity; MUT-8 binding maps to a C. elegans-specific insertion in MUT7-C
context: C. elegans and human MUT-7; in vitro
confidence_and_limitations: High; assigns RNA binding to MUT-7 rather than MUT-8

evidence_type: computational (CALVADOS2 / Martini3 / atomistic MD) with in vitro validation of MUT-16 IDR phase separation
claim_tested: Does an RDE-2 IDR engage a condensate?
key_finding: MUT-8 N-terminal prion-like domain binds the MUT-16 M8BR cluster through cation-pi contacts between MUT-8 Tyr and MUT-16 Arg
context: Simulation; MUT-16 IDR relative phase-separation propensities confirmed in vitro
confidence_and_limitations: Medium-high for the interaction mode; autonomous condensation by the MUT-8 PLD alone is not demonstrated

key_finding: MUT-16 C-terminal region containing predicted disorder is necessary and sufficient to promote Mutator foci; foci have properties consistent with a phase-separated condensate
confidence_and_limitations: High; establishes MUT-16 as the scaffold and RDE-2/MUT-8 as a recruited client

claim_tested: Does RDE-2 localize to Mutator foci?
key_finding: Each of the six mutator proteins localizes to perinuclear germline foci; MUT-16 is required for mutator complex formation and focus assembly
confidence_and_limitations: High for localization; silent on RDE-2 RNA binding

key_finding: RDE-2/MUT-8 identified as a component of the MUT-7 complex; the interaction is required for efficient RNAi in vivo
context: C. elegans; yeast two-hybrid and complex fractionation
confidence_and_limitations: High for the interaction; no domain-level mapping

key_finding: IntAct reports only MUT-7 (P34607) and RBM-12 (Q9U304, an RRM protein) as RDE-2 partners
confidence_and_limitations: Low-medium; single high-throughput source with no orthogonal validation

claim_tested: Does RDE-2 carry any recognised domain?
key_finding: HTTP 204 No Content: zero signatures across all InterPro member databases; positive controls MUT-7 (15 entries) and SIMR-1 (7 entries) returned normally; MUT-16 also 204
confidence_and_limitations: High; the UniProt and PDBe name "SH2 domain-containing protein" comes from EMBL CAA95803.3 (ECO:0000313) with no SH2 signature behind it

claim_tested: Do the RDE-2 IDRs carry RNA-binding sequence signatures?
key_finding: 0 RGG tripeptides, 0 RG-box spacings (RG.{0,2}RG), 0 windows of 10 residues with >=5 Lys/Arg, net charge -18; acidic IDRs NCPR -0.127 (216-294) and -0.130 (297-350); benchmark panel: PGL-1 1.37 RGG/100aa + 4 K/R patches, MUT-16 22 patches, MEG-3 15, MUT-7 14
context: Q19672 plus a 13-protein C. elegans mutator and germ-granule panel; three orthologs
confidence_and_limitations: High as a sequence-level null result; composition cannot exclude a structured RNA-binding surface on the folded CTD

claim_tested: Is the N-terminal prion-like domain real and conserved?
key_finding: Residues 1-45: Tyr 15.6%, aromatic 17.8%, Gln+Asn 26.7%, zero charged residues in 1-40; identity 53.3% (C. briggsae A8Y196) and 48.9% (C. nigoni A0A2G5VH88) versus 45.5% and 45.7% protein-wide; acidic IDRs least conserved at 26.6-38.9%
context: Four Caenorhabditis orthologs; BLOSUM62 affine-gap global alignment
confidence_and_limitations: Medium-high; the C. remanei model E3NE06 lacks the N-terminal block and looks 5'-incomplete rather than genuinely PLD-less

claim_tested: How reliable is the AlphaFold monomer for this protein?
key_finding: Global pLDDT 41.5; Kabsch CA RMSD 5.55 A over 326-567 and 5.22 A over the 356-567 core against 8Q66 chain B; mean pLDDT 37.6 across the crystallographically helical 326-355
context: AF-Q19672-F1 v6 versus PDB 8Q66 chain B
confidence_and_limitations: High; shows pLDDT alone over-calls disorder for this protein and should not be the sole basis for an IDR claim
